text:
alex: FYI - customer AcmeCorp (PROD-4987) reports tool-call args arriving truncated on our runtime during stream -> schema validation fails. They provided stream output that ends mid-JSON. Can someone triage?

alex: repro shows SSE/chunked stream where a tool_call payload is cut off, e.g.:
```
data: {\"id\":\"evt_1\",\"type\":\"tool_call\",\"payload\":\"{\\\"tool\\\":\\\"search\\\",\\\"args\\\":{\\\"query\\\":\\\"pricing for redwood i\\\"}}\ndata: {\"id\":\"evt_2\",\"type\":\"tool_call\",\"payload\":\"{\\\"tool\\\":\\\"search\\\",\\\"args\\\":{\\\"query\\\":\\\"pricing for redwood inc\\\"}}\n```
(see how payload string itself is cut in the middle)

alex: ticket attached with request_id=req_0a1b2c3d and customer proxy logs. Any quick ideas?

josh: ack. That pattern smells like chunked transfer / proxy buffer split. Do we know which proxy in front of their private deploy? nginx? envoy?

katie: customer says they put our private node behind nginx (default template) and also use HTTP/1.1 with chunked responses. Can we get nginx error log excerpt?

alex: they sent this log snippet: 
```
[error] 12345#0: *6789 recv() failed (104: Connection reset by peer) while reading response header from upstream, client: 10.0.0.5, server: _, request: \"POST /v1/chat/stream HTTP/1.1\", upstream: \"http://127.0.0.1:9000/\", host: \"api.redwood.internal\"
```
and also upstream closed stream while sending chunked body.

support-bot: Incident created INC-2026 and linked to PROD-4987. Assigned to eng-infra.

josh: quick triage notes — when nginx proxy_buffering is enabled it can split streaming chunks across buffer boundaries; also chunked transfer encoding frames can split JSON strings mid-UTF8 sequence. Our runtime expects each SSE \"data:\" line to contain a complete JSON payload for tool_call; partial payloads cause schema validation to reject.

josh: actions to try: 1) Ask customer to set `proxy_buffering off;` for the /v1/chat/stream location and `proxy_http_version 1.1; chunked_transfer_encoding on;` 2) As a mitigation, we can make the runtime coalesce partial payload lines before parsing tool_call JSON.

katie: there's a PR in SDK/runtime that coalesces partial events (PR #3123) — it adds a small buffer to wait for end-of-event when parsing streaming payloads. That branch is in v0.9.4. Recommend customer upgrade SDK client if they're using our SDK, and/or we push a server-side patch.

alex: repro steps I'm running locally to simulate:
```bash
# start simple node server that streams SSE and intentionally splits JSON across writes
node simulate-split.js 
# curl with no buffering to replicate consumer
curl -N -H 'Accept: text/event-stream' http://localhost:4000/stream
```
(simulate-split.js writes `data: {\"tool_call\": \"{\\\"tool\\\":\\\"search\\\", \\\"args\\\": {\\\"query\\\": \\\"pricing` then after delay writes rest)

support-jen: bumping priority to P1 for customer-facing production impact. Please post ETA for fix and temporary workaround for AcmeCorp.

eng-infra: We're on it. Short-term hotfix: update default nginx template for private deploys to include `proxy_buffering off;` for stream endpoints and increase `proxy_read_timeout` to 120s. We'll also backport runtime coalescing buffer to v1.4.7. ETA 4 hours for config rollout + runtime patch to staging, 8 hours to prod after validation.

josh: note — HTTP/2 behaves differently (frame-based) and some in-path proxies may still split frames. Coalescing at runtime is the more robust fix. We'll add a debug flag to log if we see partial payload merges for a short window after rollout.

alex: shared workaround to customer: 1) set nginx `proxy_buffering off;` 2) upgrade to SDK v0.9.4 if using SDK 3) we'll target runtime patch and let you know when rolled out.

eng-infra: hotfix deployed to template in staging at 2025-11-18T09:20Z, runtime v1.4.7 with coalescing parser deployed to canary. Please test.

alex: customer confirmed after applying `proxy_buffering off` they no longer see truncated tool args. They will test SDK upgrade also.

eng-infra: prod rollout completed at 2025-11-18T15:02Z for private templates and runtime patch. Monitoring shows no further partial-toolcall errors for that tenant. Closing PROD-4987 pending customer sign-off.

support-jen: thanks everyone. Saved by combining config + runtime buffer. We'll add a short KB doc and include nginx snippet in private deploy quickstart.
